The institutional investor held 7,736 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.19M, down from 11,682 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Investment Management Llc who had been investing in International Bus Mach for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $133.56 billion market cap company.
